verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents version control and deployment labels for centrally managed prompts, and users can review new prompt versions through experiments, side-by-side comparison and CI/CD regression gates. A user confirms the prompt versioning is valuable in practice. But this covers prompts, the closest Langfuse analog to automations, rather than automations broadly, and rollback is only implied by labels; one user rated its prompt management behind PromptLayer on git-like versioning and easy rollback. missing for 10: explicit rollback documentation, versioning of automations beyond prompts (e.g. evaluator rules or pipelines), a documented change-review/approval workflow, independent hands-on confirmation of rollback.
